# Responsible data use — source and currency record

Legal commencement and coverage guidance rechecked 15 October 2026; other source checks dated 13 October 2026. Original classroom explanations/scenarios; linked official documents retain their own terms.

- 2026 SCSA Year 11 syllabus: https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0020/1232507/Computer-Science-ATAR-Year-11-Syllabus-for-teaching-from-2026.PDF
- Official APP text: https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/australian-privacy-principles/read-the-australian-privacy-principles
- Personal information: https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/your-privacy-rights/your-personal-information/what-is-personal-information
- Federal public-agency coverage: https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/your-privacy-rights/more-privacy-rights/government-agencies
- WA transition/commencement: https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/office-of-the-information-commissioner/personal-information-collected-and-after-1-july-2026
- WA retention/recordkeeping: https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/state-records-office-of-western-australia/privacy-and-responsible-information-sharing-act-2024-and-record-keeping-obligations
- ASD assurance context: https://www.cyber.gov.au/ism/2026-09/guidelines-for-security-assurance

The selected APP table is a study aid, not all 13 principles or exceptions. Federal APPs and WA IPPs are separate. WA guidance identifies most substantive privacy provisions from 1 July 2026 and notifiable information breach provisions from 1 January 2027, with transitional qualifications. Check current legislation and authorised organisational procedures before operational use. No classroom exercise grants disclosure, disposal or testing authority.
